title: Microsoft Copilot Chat: side pane in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and OneNote for commercial Microsoft 365 users
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing statements and listed controls are supported. Minor corrections should attribute the opening availability statement to the roadmap, retain Microsoft's current-version qualification for the privacy control, and acknowledge the narrower side-pane control in the risk rationale.

claims.claim: The item concerns Copilot Chat in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and OneNote.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)", "Excel", "Word", "PowerPoint", "Outlook", "OneNote"]

claims.where: What's changing: opening; summary; Scope: Users; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Commercial Microsoft 365 licence holders and Microsoft 365 Copilot licence holders can access the side pane according to the roadmap.
claims.quote: Easily access Copilot Chat from the side pane in your Microsoft 365 apps with a commercial Microsoft 365 license or a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
claims.fix: Replace the opening sentence with 'The launched roadmap item describes access to Copilot Chat from the side pane in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and OneNote with a commercial Microsoft 365 licence or a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.' This keeps the roadmap attribution explicit beside the later Learn qualifications.

claims.where: rationale: risk
claims.claim: The documented connected-experiences off switch is a broad privacy policy.
claims.quote: You can use the Allow the use of connected experiences in Office that analyze content policy setting to control whether these types of connected experiences are available to your users.
claims.fix: Replace the risk rationale with 'Medium. Users without a Copilot licence can send open document content to Copilot Chat; Enterprise Data Protection applies and Basic chat cannot use Microsoft Graph. Microsoft documents a narrower side-pane policy for unlicensed users as well as the broader connected-experiences privacy policy.' The narrower policy is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources#copilotchatsidepane-resource-type.
